title: Mumbai Mithaiwala's FSSAI Licence Suspended After Man Finds Stapler Pin in Kaju Katli
summary: The FSSAI licence of Tewari Bros. Mithaiwala, a popular mithai dukaan in Mumbai, has been suspended after a man claimed to have found a stapler pin in their kaju katli. The incident occurred at the shop's premises in Mumbai. The man alleged that he had found the metal object while consuming the kaju katli. The Maharashtra FDA took action and suspended the licence.
summary_points: The FSSAI licence of Tewari Bros. Mithaiwala has been suspended.
